paging_helper_capture.method: Production semantic helper invoked inside DF; paged row counts/text/order compared with native widget list; source logs unchanged. Combat97 spans2 pages; Sparring11 one; empty Hunting one.
limitations: Helper only; compiled UnitList schema and consumers not integrated
Revision stale-list rejection is offline-tested, not yet live-mutated

log_helper_capture.method: Production UnitLog helper runs in DF over unmodified unit report vectors, comparing all retained IDs in exact order for every existing Combat/Sparring log, both directions. Oracle reads raw DF logs independently.
limitations: Helper-only acceptance; UnitLog public transport remains unavailable
No native unit-log view click or visual acceptance
Live logs unchanged; trim/growth mutation cases are offline tests

compiled_transport_capture.method: Godot report_request through model/wire/compiled bridge. Paged UnitList rows compared against native names/professions/dead flags/counts/order; every retained native unit-log ID compared in both directions.
compiled_transport_capture.rejected_attempt: 052504 lacked required helper message field. Fixed dispatcher envelope, added integrated regression, rebuilt bridge and reran.
limitations: Live stale-list mutation, additional professions and native log navigation remain open

controller_capture.method: Protected paused clone. Actual reports_controller and semantic_action_service with live Df3dWorld. Native unit identity/name/profession and retained log IDs compared with oracle units.json.
limitations: No live epoch/disconnect injection; these use offline lifecycle checks
One Sparring unit log tested through controller; broader transport coverage recorded separately

category_rendering.method: Native pointer clicks to all three category tabs. Hunting seeded with one existing report reference on owned paused clone; label text is native. RGB sampled from first-row glyph pixels.
